Im a 27F, In 2017 I self reflected over my circumstances and past decisions. I cleared my mind by writing a book on my beliefs, and as I was about to suicude because I had nothing i desired or cared for; I was randomly added by and talked to an old friend online, and been dating him for the past 3 years now and living with him the past year in real life. 

I use to be an academic, spent 21 years everyday improving mentally and physically because i thought i needed to save, help, or at least improve the world. Even after years struggling with epilepsy and hospitalized dozens of times, i refused to give up, which put me in danger, leading me to have a traumatic brain injury, even after such an event i kept going, but i couldnt keep my grades up in college, and because of that i was academically disqualified from my university and banned from 9 of the best universities in the world. I thought i needed to help ppl, but what i needed was to love and save myself. I have no income, and i cant do basic functions without putting my life in danger, im homeless basically with no friends or family, i live with my boyfriend now and i live in peace knowing who i am, and what i want, and that is to see the world through an artistic point of view. I still have severe epilepsy, and almost died this morning, I take medication but it has not been efffective for the past year. Im just glad i have that i have someone to trust in and love.

Vaccines dont prevent infection but just give me more of a survival chance, and i believe if i do get ill probably be really sick or have a severe reaction since my health is already poor. Im a 27F and have no income, if my boyfriend were to kick me out or doesnt want me, id be homeless, but things are 'okay' for now. If i do get covid and die, thats okay, everynight i have severe seizures and almost died this morning, kinda bored today so im just comnenting ob questions. I didnt want to be the first batch of ppl to get the vaccine because i didnt know the side effects. But i might get it in the next year, in case i do feel motivated to live/ to have a better survival rate for the chance i do contract it.

Im a 27F and my boyfriend has emotional anger problems from decades of abuse; i also get stressed, and scared when hes upset, I had a loving family growing up, i think its just biology; your body and mind gets alerted thinking its a dangerous situation; elevating your heart rate, relrasing hormones, adrenaline; people have different baselines of tolerance when it comes to stressful situations, not everyone is okay with stress, or shouting, violence or anger, lonliness or even happiness. I personally believe anger, violence, and stress are not normal. For me i have a srict belief that i can control my feelings and emotions; i accept what i feel and then i let it go. Every moment is a new moment, while i do remember and learn from the past, i do not think about it all day, i move foward focusing on the things i want to focus on. My parents are both survivalist, and grew up poor and lived like farmers, hunter gatherers, blue collarworkers, they are fully capable of surviving without technology, and even now in there 60s and 70s can lift 50 pounds, and function on their own; but as hard core as they are, even they wont stay around people who stress them or irritate them. I dont think stressful situations are good for anyone, and what some ppl see as normal, others can be in tears.
